instruction: I want plain text emails to wrap at 72 characters per line for better readability. Could you help me configure Thunderbird to set the plain text wrapping width to 72 characters?

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting plain text wrapping width by configuring mailnews.wraplength to 72. This preference controls the number of characters per line before text wraps in plain text emails.
metadata.verification: The preference mailnews.wraplength is a standard Thunderbird setting that controls plain text line wrapping. Common values are 72 (RFC standard) or 0 (no wrapping).
